cases.title: Filter panel reserves space and leaves results interactive
cases.scope: Nonmodal push geometry, narrow stacking, no backdrop/inert results, pointer and keyboard access. Does not test every facet or query rule.

cases.title: Each density choice changes both selected state and rendered rows
cases.scope: Compact/default/comfortable selected state and strictly increasing measured row heights. Does not certify all token ownership or grid behavior.

cases.title: Keyboard opening and Escape dismissal restore focus to the opener
cases.scope: Normal surviving opener with Enter, initial focus, Escape and focus return. Does not certify pointer dismissal or removed opener recovery.
